title: 🏛️ RBI Credit Risk Directions 2026 — Materiality Thresholds on Related-Party Lending
summary: RBI set transaction-level board approval ceilings for related-party loans: ₹25 Cr for banks with assets >₹10T, ₹10 Cr for assets ₹1T–₹10T, and ₹5 Cr for assets <₹1T. Applicable from April 1, 2026.

blocks.content: **Overview**: RBI set transaction-level board approval ceilings for related-party loans: ₹25 Cr for banks with assets >₹10T, ₹10 Cr for assets ₹1T–₹10T, and ₹5 Cr for assets <₹1T. Applicable from April 1, 2026.

items: **RBI Commercial Banks Credit Risk Directions 2026: Materiality Thresholds on Related-Party Loans** (Page 17): RBI set transaction-level board approval ceilings for related-party loans: ₹25 Cr for banks with assets >₹10T, ₹10 Cr for assets ₹1T–₹10T, and ₹5 Cr for assets <₹1T. Applicable from April 1, 2026.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Bank & NBFC Credit Governance & Connected Lending. Prescribes mandatory board approval ceilings for related-party loans: Banks >₹10T at ₹50 Cr, ₹1T-10T at ₹10 Cr, NBFC Upper Layer at ₹10 Cr.
